audit_items.proof_trace: Both operations use truncating integer division: `int_div(collateral_amount, exchange_rate)` = `WAD * collateral / exchange_rate.value` (floors), and `exchange_rate.int_mul(ctokens.value)` = `(rate.value * ctokens) / WAD` (floors). Both round down, satisfying the property that mint rounds against the depositor and redeem rounds against the redeemer.
